channel.description: Neutral, dated official-source election briefs from AfroTools.

item.title: Cabo Verde court admits five presidential candidacies; appeals were available
item.description: The electoral commission's 22 September notice reports an admissibility decision for the 15 November presidential election. It is not a final post-appeal candidate roster.

item.title: South Africa: Special-vote applications close 12 Oct
item.description: The Electoral Commission says applications opened on 21 September for special votes ahead of the 4 November local elections. The deadline is 17:00 on 12 October.
